summary:
I developed a project that mixes podcast with subtitles and a quiz.
It makes my goal ,which is to make science more accesible to kids and disabled people, possible because I can use tools like subtitles so death people can learn too for example
details:
My project basically has one goal wich is to turn science easier to be learned since a you age, by turning it in an accessible subject fot all people like kids and disabled people.

By making science something fun and accesible I hope we will have a generation with a lot of science enthusiasts leading to evolutions, inventions and discoveries.

In order to make this project I had to research, write what I had to say, record me explaining, then turning it more accesible by using subtitles and for last I made a quiz for people to have fun while learning and test their knowlodge.

My project is very creative because my goal was to explain a lot in short time but mostly my goal was not being creative it was making my project accesible for most people.
